titles.title: Pink Tulip

description: Vertical narrow canvas of an abstract section of a pink tulip.  The upper quadrant of the picture plane encapsulates a large rounded draping petal shape in gradient shades of pink with an arc of yellow at the bottom of the form. To the left of the petal, cutting on a diagonal of the canvas, is a soft vertical  bolt-like rod of blues and green along with ruffled rows of yellow shapes.
title: Pink Tulip
